summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of the ANELEC TCE mockup gallery. Tested all 5 design directions (Atlas, Craft, Signal, Swiss, Bento), gallery navigation, viewer functionality, compare view, mock screen interactions, modals, command palette, and mobile responsive views. All core features are working correctly.

design_issues.issue: Mobile bottom navigation bar (data-testid='mock-mobile-nav') may not be consistently visible or positioned correctly on some screens
design_issues.note: Mobile layout is functional but some test IDs may need verification

design_issues.issue: Some terrain screen test IDs (data-testid='mock-screen-terrain') may be missing or inconsistent
design_issues.note: Terrain app loads and functions correctly, just test ID consistency could be improved
